The Algerian international made no mistake, firing his effort past the goalkeeper to give Neom SC a dream start and send the home crowd into raptures. For much of the opening period, Neom SC looked the more likely to double their advantage, controlling the tempo and forcing Al Hazm into a defensive shell. After a foul in the area, the referee pointed to the spot, leaving the responsibility to the veteran marksman Alexandre Lacazette . In the 48th minute (45+3'), the former Lyon striker stepped up with the chance to effectively put the game out of reach. However, his effort failed to find the back of the net, providing Al Hazm with a vital lifeline heading into the locker rooms. The second half saw a shift in intensity, with Al Hazm emerging from the break with renewed vigor. The game became increasingly physical, as evidenced by Nathan Zeze receiving a yellow card in the 51st minute. The finish was composed and clinical, pulling Al Hazm level and completely altering the complexion of the match. Neom SC introduced Luciano Rodriguez and later Ahmed Al Anazi , while Al Hazm fortified their defensive lines with Miguel Carvalho . As the match entered its final stages, the referee was kept busy, brandishing yellow cards to Abdulrahman Al Khaibary , Abdulmalik Al Oyayari , and Ahmed Al-Shamrani as the battle for the ball grew more desperate. Despite late substitutions that saw Amadou Bamba Dieng and Sultan Tanker enter the fray for Neom SC , the breakthrough remained elusive. The final whistle blew after five minutes of added time, leaving Neom SC to reflect on a missed opportunity while Al Hazm celebrated a resilient away performance.
